title: PaperStats
description: A plugin for paper servers adding ram-bar and tps-bar and some other features helping you keep track of the lag!
body:
# PaperStats

A lightweight, high-performance server statistics HUD designed to give administrators and players a real-time view of server performance metrics.

---

## Features

- **Real-Time TPS & MSPT Bar**: Monitor ticks per second and milliseconds per tick dynamically.
- **RAM & CPU Monitor**: Keep an eye on memory consumption and processor load accurately.
- **Dynamic Colors**: BossBars change colors based on consumption or health levels automatically:
  - **TPS**: Green (High) | Yellow (Medium) | Red (Low)
  - **RAM**: Red (High) | Yellow (Medium) | Blue (Normal)
- **Lightweight & Async**: Runs updates asynchronously to ensure zero impact on server ticks.

---

## Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/tpsbar` | Toggle the TPS & MSPT BossBar | `paperstats.tpsbar` |
| `/rambar` | Toggle the RAM & CPU BossBar | `paperstats.rambar` |
| `/stats` | View a quick text report of server stats | `paperstats.stats` |

Note: `/serverstats` is available as an alias for `/stats`.

---

## Installation & Requirements

1. Download the `PaperStats.jar` file.
2. Place it into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart or reload your server.
4. Verify using `/stats` in-game.

*Requires Paper or forks supporting sub-tick performance metrics (1.21+).*
